title: A closing fork must not write receipts: the owning session writes them (candidate; cost unmeasured)
why: Guard queued per rule building-mistake-names-its-guard (queued as step:writer-never-writes-receipts). Mistake: triage's close forks wrote the receipts doc themselves on six items closed since 20:00 CST Nov 14: 849 (pick-carry-clean-merge-replacement), 851 (pick-records-page-clean-merge-tree), 852 (pick-debt-step-skip-guard-rerun), 328 (qmax-d369-error-source), 861 (pick-standing-sessions-tiny-fixes), 865 (pick-3381-accept-checks-loss). Rule: skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md line 195 'receipts/<id>: written by the owning session, never by the page'; lines 286-288 'The writer never writes receipts'; Route and close step 1 (lines ~467-469): the owning session writes read, then filed. Read-only check (ArtifactData, 02:43 CST): all six receipts carry a read and filed time equal or within seconds of the close time (for 849, 852, 328, 861 read equals filed; 865 read 07:44:20Z, filed 07:44:50Z); the owner field on each names the coordinator, the consultant or a lane, never triage. So each receipt looks writer-written. Harm: a false 'read' time on the page, because the owning session never read or filed at that time. Older closes were not checked. Guard idea: the brief for a closing fork says 'the owning session writes the receipt; do not write receipts', and the page writer's close script or the fork brief template refuses a receipts/<id> write by the writer. Cost: unmeasured (one line in each close brief). The fix to triage's own brief applies from now: every closing fork brief says 'the owner session writes the receipt; do not write receipts'. Open: whether a writer-written receipt on a chat answer is acceptable (the skill says no; a consultant or owner ruling could allow it). Nothing was changed on the page: read-only check. 02:44 CST Nov 15, consultant ruled (b) (consultant's pick under the owner's 20:18 words, not owner-typed): for a chat-relayed answer the relaying session is the reader; receipts 861 and 865 rewritten by triage: 861 read 06:50:00Z (consultant 00:50 CST, relayed 00:55), filed 06:51:35Z (ruling own-tiny-fixes-b commit a1e68333d; was 06:51:13Z/06:51:13Z); 865 read 07:43:00Z (01:43 CST), filed 07:45:29Z (ruling own-3381-a commit 1e42c62b6; was 07:44:20Z/07:44:50Z); each carries a writtenBy field 'written by triage for the consultant's chat read' (a new field: the receipts doc had only read and filed). Read back at version 2. 849, 851, 852, 328 not rewritten (consultant named only 861 and 865). The skill sentence (SKILL.md lines 195, 286-288) is still to amend to name the chat-relayed case; no lane yet. 02:46 CST Nov 15, consultant ruled (a) on the other four (consultant's pick under the owner's 20:18 words, not owner-typed): all four answers reached the consultant (849 a, 852 '2', 328 'none of these' via triage relays at about 00:12 CST; 851 via the coordinator's 23:44 CST test and the consultant's 23:45 close). Rewritten by triage, each read back at version 2, each with writtenBy: 849 read 06:12:00Z (approx; was 06:13:49Z), filed 06:11:40Z (ruling own-849-a-replacement-carry-clean-merge commit 292409f30; was 06:13:49Z); 851 read 05:45:00Z (23:45 CST Nov 14; was 2026-11-14T23:43:00-06:00), filed 05:43:46Z (first commit of own-records-page-fresh-review 0ad455417; the old filed text, a ruling path and relay line, is kept in a new filedRef field); 852 read 06:12:00Z (approx; was 06:16:00Z), filed 06:17:53Z (own-852-1 commit fae506714; was 06:16:00Z); 328 read 06:12:00Z (approx; was 06:20:33Z), filed 06:23:04Z (own-328-c commit 9633447fd; was 06:20:33Z). Flag: for 849 and 851 the ruling commit time is earlier than the consultant's stated read time (849: filed 06:11:40Z, read 06:12:00Z; 851: filed 05:43:46Z, read 05:45:00Z), so the receipt reads filed-before-read; the ruling was written from the coordinator's or owner's earlier word and the consultant's read time is as he stated it. All six receipts (849 851 852 328 861 865) are now rewritten; the skill sentence at SKILL.md lines 195 and 286-288 is still to amend.
source: Triage, 02:43 CST Nov 15, after the fork that closed item 865 reported writing its receipt and the skill text said the writer never does.
